- The only untested variation of this exact setup is the fusion method (weighted vs concat)
- config_044 is the direct logical extension: same as config_018 but with weighted fusion instead of concat

Given that we have 5 experiments remaining, testing the fusion method on the best-known configuration is a high-value experiment.
